scaleBeatText: 🗣️ Theo to Recep, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"
🗣️ Elias to Vasyl, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

👑 Speakers from Emberhold, Stonebridge, Thornfield ride in for the first court — and every one of them is measuring you. FEAST them from a shared granary (5,000 kcal, no strings), HOST the court at Haven's fire (your speaker's time), or write the law in COLD ink (they'll pay more and love you less). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
🗣️ Elias to Lena, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.
◈ OVERTIME ×1 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+25% HP, +12% damage). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −7. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock.
◈ OVERTIME ×2 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+50% HP, +24% damage, +1 to every pack). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −14. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock.

⚖️ "THE ACCUSED WILL RISE." The Gavel has been reviewing footage of you. It names your crime: "Day 104: Overtime ×2: the table waited, and the season kept going." The sound-block swings forward. The verdict falls NEXT round. (⚖️ Object — cite precedent · ⏳ Demand recess · 🙏 Confess first)
🔨 THE VERDICT FALLS: "Day 104: Overtime ×2: the table waited, and the season kept going." — GUILTY. (54)
◈ OVERTIME ×3 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+75% HP, +36% damage, +1 to every pack). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −24. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock.
◈ OVERTIME ×4 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+100% HP, +48% damage, +2 to every pack). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −34. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock.
◈ OVERTIME ×5 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+125% HP, +60% damage, +2 to every pack). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −38. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock.
OVERTIME ×6! MAXIMUM OVERTIME! The table is still set. The chair is getting cold. Sit — or don't! We LOVE this!
◈ OVERTIME ×6 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+150% HP, +72% damage, +3 to every pack). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −40. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock.
🗣️ Haoyu to Devon, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."
